body_text:
Before selling your property, there are 3 key factors that can influence how much you eventually sell for.
Unfortunately, many homeowners only realise this after their property is already sold.
I’m Irene from Huttons Group, and I’ve helped homeowners complete 300+ property transactions across Singapore.
If you're planning your next move, I’m offering a complimentary Home Selling Strategy Report, which includes:
✔ Estimated home valuation
✔ Nearby transaction comparison
✔ Market insights on buyer demand
✔ Possible upgrade pathways
Leave your details and I’ll prepare the report for you.

headline: Find Out What Your Property Is Worth Today
transcript_text: Most homeowners actually lose tens of thousands of dollars when selling their property, and they don't even realize it. Because they think selling is simple, just lease it online and wait for a buyer. But the truth is, how you sell can directly affect how much you sell for. Hi, I'm Irene, a real estate agent in Singapore. Over the years, I've completed more than 300 property transactions, helping homeowners to sell, upgrade and plan their next move with confidence. Through these experiences, I developed three-part framework to help whole owners to sell strategically. I studied recent transactions, buyer demand and competing listings to position your property so it stands out and attracts serious buyers. Pricing isn't about choosing the highest number. Strategic pricing creates stronger demand, more viewings and sometimes even competitive offers. It's about presenting your property the right way, reaching the right buyers and negotiating effectively to secure the best outcome. If you're thinking about selling, upgrading or just exploring your options, feel free to reach out. I'll be happy to share your property selling strategy.
